rules: A keepClear zone bars the kinds it lists; kinds are planter, lamp, bollard, tree, parasol, band.

Every Handover point (mission.json destinations and crew): no planter, lamp, bollard or tree within 1.2 m; no parasol whose disc (R 1.3, rim 2.07 m) covers it or a person standing on it as the play camera sees them (the line from 0.35 m to 2.65 m out from the point toward the camera, direction +0.866 x, -0.5 y, stays outside the disc).
Bands are flat inlay (4 mm): they may pass under a Handover point or a walk. They may not enter a bay, crew-line-getaway, the steps or landing, or a planting bed.
Lamp rings (InlayArc_R2_W06, four per ring, R 2.3 outside) go only where `ring` is true and are centred on the pole.
Anything not placed here stays off the ground between the two buildings: ask Vantage.
